title: Add Table Load Management
objective: Learn how to use the 'housekeeping cycle' to manage table loads and how to
provide a function that validates a table's content prior to it being activated.

exercise.instructions: 1. Add the '...OUT_OF_RANGE_ERR_CODE' and the '...TBL_ELEMENT_1_MAX' macro definitions from the exercise window.
1. Add the table validation function prototype 'CFE_Status_t @TEMPLATE@_TblValidationFunc(void *TblData);'.
1. Copy the table validation function @TEMPLATE@_TblValidationFunc() from the exercise window.

1. Locate the call to CFE_TBL_Register() added to @TEMPLATE@_Init() in the previous lesson. Change the NULL parameter to
    @TEMPLATE@_TblValidationFunc
